about_the_game:
Depths of Apollyon is a third-person open-world action RPG set in a decaying medieval land laced with remnants of forbidden technology. An ancient AI governs the world’s fate — and you must decide whether to destroy it or bend it to your will.

Fight through corrupted beasts, cybernetic horrors, and towering biomechanical bosses in fast-paced hack-and-slash combat. Wield swords, greatswords, bows, and soon staffs and magic — each with combo systems, executions, and gear that changes your playstyle.

Traverse ruins, fortresses, and wilderness with freedom: wall-run across broken towers, grapple through chasms, and chain acrobatic moves to outmaneuver both enemies and the terrain itself.

Play solo or join up to 4 players in seamless online co-op. Build your character through quests, loot, and a branching skill tree as you explore a world where medieval myth collides with ancient high technology.

Will you uncover the truth behind Apollyon — or be consumed by its depths?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT (8GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
